# Synthetic game decoder oracle fixtures

These files contain no game assets. Inputs use the deterministic byte formula
in `provenance.json`; outputs were generated by compiling the exact baseline
MIT-licensed `NetEaseUtils.cs` with a no-op logger and a span-search helper, then
calling `DecryptWithoutHeader` or `DecryptWithHeader`. The Rust implementation
was checked byte-for-byte against all nine boundary cases recorded in the work
log; three representative outputs are retained here to prevent regressions.

The managed oracle was run only as temporary development infrastructure. The
Rust app, tests, CI and release packages do not need .NET. Source copyright:
Razmoth, under the repository MIT license. These fixtures establish algorithm
translation for synthetic bytes, not compatibility with a real game build.
